name: NGC 718 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 718, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc718-hubble
story: NGC 718 is an early-type spiral with an unusual bar region. Ground-based pictures show arcs that appear sculpted by dust around a circular ring at its center. It was chosen as a quiet counterpart to galaxies with active black holes.

claims.text: NGC 718 is a bright early-type spiral, type (R')SAB(rs)a
Its bar region shows bright arcs and dark arcs that appear sculpted by dust, with a circular nuclear ring in the center
NGC 718 is an inactive control galaxy matched to AGN
